Mobile internet coverage by number of districts (83,937). Indonesia · school connectivity11  Next steps
Recommendations for short-term next steps (case study p.66). Pilot 3 builds on refinements from the Sumatra pilot before extending. Source: BCG analysis.INDEPENDENT REDESIGN · 11 / 11

Next: set up working teams, run four pilots across the islands, then test the regulatory room

Step 1
Set up working teams
Support BAKTI, the government and the USO in discussing sustainable funding models
Pilot 1 · Jakarta
Demand-side subsidy · 10 schools
A small subsidy is likely to suffice; these schools cannot count on BAKTI funds
Pilot 2 · Sumatra
Revenue-sharing · 10 schools
5 in a better-connectivity area (>50% of schools), 5 in a low-connectivity area (<50%)
Pilot 3 · a less-developed island
Revenue-sharing · 10 schools
With a suitable mobile/rural operator partnership, using refinements learned in Sumatra
Pilot 4 · Papua and Kalimantan
Community contribution · 10 models
5 schools in each, with research centres, following the village / Zenzeleni model
Step 3
Research the regulatory framework
Is there enough room for telcos and ISPs to implement the sustainable funding models?
